positions.name: Magna International Inc.
positions.catalyst: Q2'26 (reported 7/31 AM) beat + RAISED FY26 outlook: record Q2 adj EPS +29% to $1.86 vs $1.51 est; sales $11.0B (+3% y/y); adj EBIT +16% to $677M, margin +70bps to 6.2%; FCF more than doubled to $617M. Raised FY26 adj EPS to $6.70-$7.30 (from $6.25-$7.25) and lifted adj EBIT margin & FCF outlook; $598M returned to shareholders in the quarter. Live pre-market last print 73.39 (bid 70.00/ask 75.00, 11:14 UTC) vs the 7/30 close of 69.85 (+5.1%).
positions.driver: Clean beat-and-raise with expanding margins, doubling free cash flow and active capital returns — a fundamentally-driven move rather than a hype spike. Entry 73.39 is only +5.1% over prior close, well below the >8-10% no-chase line, leaving room to run. Chose MGA over NVT (a superior AI-data-center beat-and-raise story) precisely because NVT was up +9.8% at an all-time high — inside the no-chase band — and going 100% all-in on an extended gapper conflicts with this book's downside-protection mandate. Definable stop 68.99 sits just under the 7/30 unchanged line / gap base.
positions.risks: Auto supplier — cyclical, tariff- and FX-sensitive, thin ~6% EBIT margins; volume tied to OEM production schedules that can soften. Thin/wide pre-market quote (70.00/75.00) means the open could reprice below the 73.39 print (sell-the-news gap-fade risk). Broad tape choppy after Meta -9% and mixed mega-cap tech earnings. Hard stop 68.99 (-6%).
